input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet on my phone is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed—nothing less will do. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need this fixed as soon as possible. Can you help?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information.
The issue is with my line, which is 555-123-2002. That’s the one I’m currently using and having trouble with mobile data.
Yes, please go ahead and check my network status and run a speed test on my device. I want to make sure I’m getting excellent internet speed.
It looks like my phone is currently in Airplane Mode, and there’s no cellular service, which is probably why the speed test failed and I’m not getting any internet. What should I do next to fix this?
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. The status bar now shows excellent signal strength, 5G connectivity, and mobile data is enabled. What should I do next to check if my internet speed is excellent?
I tried running a speed test, but it failed again and says there’s no connection. Even though the status bar shows excellent signal and 5G, I’m still not getting any internet. What should I do now?
I checked the SIM card status, and it’s active and working properly. What should I try next to get my mobile data working with excellent speed?

Here’s what I found:
- Mobile data is enabled.
- Data Saver mode is ON, which might be limiting my data usage.
- VPN is turned OFF.
- APN settings appear to be set to "internet" with the standard MMSC URL.

Should I try turning off Data Saver mode to see if that helps with my internet speed?

I turned off Data Saver mode, but when I tried running the speed test again, it still failed and says there’s no connection. This is getting frustrating—what else can I try to get excellent internet speed?
Yes, please go ahead and check my phone’s network mode preference. I want to make sure it’s set to 4G/5G preferred so I can get the best possible speed.
My phone’s network mode preference is already set to 4G/5G preferred. What should I try next to get my mobile data working with excellent speed?
Yes, please guide me through resetting my APN settings and rebooting my device. I want to make sure everything is set up correctly so I can finally get excellent internet speed.

I reset the APN settings and rebooted my device, but the speed test still fails and says there’s no connection. I’m still not getting any internet, and this is really frustrating. What else can I do to get excellent internet speed?

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information

- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.

Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.
